summary: Hudson Acquisition I Corp., a Delaware blank-check company, held a Special Meeting on September 14, 2026, at which stockholders approved the November 22, 2024 Business Combination Agreement with EUROEV Holdings Limited (BVI), Aiways Merger Sub, Inc., Aiways Automobile Europe GmbH, and Aiways Tech Limited. Roughly 98.17% of the 2,111,028 shares outstanding on the August 21, 2026 record date were represented. All proposals passed with 2,072,493 votes in favor and zero against, including the Pubco charter amendments, board election, and the 2026 Pubco Equity Incentive Plan. The SPAC de-SPACs into Aiways Europe.
